column2: General Comments:
column3: 总评：

column2: This is a very tough campaign. The last set of changes has made it even more so. The campaign has been designed for a good player playing well to get a victory on every scenario. If you are good and play very well you may get a BV, if you play bad you only get a TV or loose.
column3: 这是一场非常艰难的战役。最近一轮改动让它更难了。本战役的设计目标是：优秀的玩家只要打得好，就能在每个场景取得一场胜利。如果你水平高又打得很好，可能拿到辉煌胜利(BV)；如果打得差，就只能拿到战术胜利(TV)甚至失败。

column2: You need a combined arms army and to be very careful especially during the first turns. In most scenarios you have to take risks to satisfy the t urn limit. The upper path (first sixteen scenarios) has been significantly strengthened. The AI can match your army in most scenarios and the presence of defense scenarios, where the AI is the aggressor, creates additional problems for the player. You w ill find all kind of scenarios, air battles, sea battles, landings, etc. The weather and the terrain will also be your enemy in several scenarios. I recommend to build only a small air force, e.g., three fighters and two TBs. AD units should protect yo ur army from the air. During the last scenarios you should be very careful about buying new units. They have low possibility of surviving due to lack of experience and over-strength.
column3: 你需要一支合成兵种军队，并且要非常小心，尤其是在最初几个回合。在多数场景中，你必须冒险才能满足回合限制。上层路径（前 16 个场景）已被大幅加强。多数场景里 AI 都能与你的军队匹敌，而防御类场景（AI 是进攻方）的存在又给玩家添了额外麻烦。你会遇到各种场景：空战、海战、登陆等。在好几个场景里，天气和地形也会与你为敌。我建议只建一支小型空军，比如 3 架战斗机和 2 个战术轰炸机(TB)。防空单位应保护你的军队免遭空袭。在最后几个场景中，购买新单位要非常小心：由于缺乏经验和超编，它们存活的几率很低。

column2: Scenario 1: Stalingrad
column3: 场景 1：斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)

column2: Tough scenario. The Russians have material s uperiority in the air and on land. Very strong tanks and several heavy guns. Do not rush the issue at all. Slowly move toward the northwestern victory hex with you minor axis troops reinforced by two tanks and a mobile AD. The rest of the troops shoul d try to take the Kalach victory hex. Get support from all the artillery there. You will need it. Try to wear down the Russians tanks and guns slowly and methodically. Try to get cover for the troops in Stalingrad, withdraw the exposed infantry. Insid e the city they have the advantage over the tanks. Besides the AI will try foolishly to attack the troops inside the city instead of concentrating on the relief group. After you have taken Kalach and the NW victory hex concentrate on the Northern victory hex. You do not have power to attack the Eastern victory hexes yet. There are too many guns and the Russians receive reinforcements from that direction.
column3: 艰难的场景。俄国人在空中和地面上都占物资优势，有非常强的坦克和若干重炮。绝对不要急于求成。让你的轴心小国部队在两辆坦克和一个机动防空单位的加强下，缓慢向西北胜利格推进。其余部队应设法夺取卡拉奇(Kalach)胜利格，并从那边的所有炮兵取得支援——你会需要它。要缓慢而有条理地消耗俄国人的坦克和火炮。设法为斯大林格勒城内的部队找掩护，把暴露的步兵撤下来；在城内，他们对坦克占优势。此外，AI 会愚蠢地试图攻击城内部队，而不是集中力量对付解围集团。拿下卡拉奇和西北胜利格后，集中力量打北方胜利格。你还没有力量进攻东面的胜利格：那里的火炮太多，而且俄国人会从那个方向得到补充兵员。

column2: After taking the Northern victory hex you should be almost at the deadline for brilliant victory. In any case you should attack in mass with all your troops the two remaining victory hexes. By this time no Russian tanks should be alive, but the Russians have at least three heavy guns. Put your tanks and auxiliary infantry at front and your guns, esp e cially the 17K18 right behind. You are going to take loses and some of your core units may be hit pretty badly, but you should overwhelm the Russian position. Only an AI playing worse than usual will allow you to win a BV. I always got victories, but I seldom lost a core unit.
column3: 拿下北方胜利格之后，你应该已经接近辉煌胜利的时限。无论如何，你都应集中全部兵力猛攻剩下的两个胜利格。到这时俄国坦克应该已被消灭干净，但俄国人至少还有 3 门重炮。把坦克和辅助步兵放在前面，火炮——尤其是 17K18——紧随其后。你会遭受损失，一些核心单位可能被打得很惨，但你应该能压垮俄国人的阵地。只有 AI 打得比平时更差，你才可能拿到辉煌胜利(BV)。我总是拿到胜利(V)，但很少损失核心单位。

column2: Scenario 2: Tunisia
column3: 场景 2：突尼斯(Tunisia)

column2: I bought a gun and a mobile AD. I over-strenghtened my tanks and AD units. Very tough scenario. The allies have many planes and the Royal Navy helps them in defending the eastern victory hex, that is a po rt. The ships sometimes even occupied the hex. You should divide your army in three groups. Swing the western group in-between the French and the American victory hex and coordinate your attack with the central group. Do not hurry, the first couple of turns can be a nightmare, especially from the air. Hide your planes for 2 or 3 turns. The AI will send planes close to your AD units, weaken them and then finished them with your fighters. Use your long-range guns on the eastern side of the port at max imum range. Otherwise you can be badly hit by the ships.
column3: 我买了一门火炮和一个机动防空单位，并把我的坦克和防空单位超编。非常艰难的场景。盟军飞机很多，皇家海军还帮他们防守东面的胜利格——那是个港口；敌舰有时甚至直接占据该格。你应把军队分成三群。让西面那群在法国和美国胜利格之间穿插，并与中央那群协同进攻。不要着急，最初两三个回合可能是噩梦，尤其是来自空中的威胁。把你的飞机藏 2 到 3 个回合。AI 会把飞机送到你的防空单位附近，让它们被削弱，然后由你的战斗机把它们打掉。把远程火炮部署在港口东侧，以最大射程射击，否则你可能会被敌舰打得很惨。

column2: After you capture the French victory hex swing the central and western groups toward the American victory hex. Beware of supply problems. It is a desert.
column3: 夺取法国胜利格后，让中央和西面两群转向美国胜利格。当心补给问题——这里是沙漠。

column2: Notes: I added an extra gun for the central group and changed the weather to South Europe.
column3: 附注：我为中央那群多加了一门火炮，并把天气改为南欧。

column2: Scenario 3: Kharkov Counterattack
column3: 场景 3：哈尔科夫反击(Kharkov Counterattack)

column2: I upgraded a tank to Tiger, and I bought a range 2 IVG tank. Moderate difficulty. Even a BV is possible. You should divide your troops in two groups, one in the No rth and one in the South. The Northwest victory hex cannot be defended, therefore, withdraw at least your gun from there. You have enough force to start attacking in the South. Defend during the first scenarios in the North. The main advantage you hav e is the range two tanks. The Soviets have heavy armor, but nothing comparable. They also have several fighters. You should have at least two fighters. Slowly proceed to attack weakened planes after they were hit by your AD units. If you have an oppor tunity go for the bombers.
column3: 我把一辆坦克升级为 Tiger，并买了一辆射程 2 的 IVG 坦克。难度中等，连辉煌胜利都有可能。你应把部队分成两群，一群在北、一群在南。西北胜利格守不住，所以至少把火炮从那里撤走。你有足够兵力在南面发起进攻。在北面前几个场景先取守势。你最大的优势是射程 2 的坦克。苏军有重装甲，但没有能与之相比的东西；他们还有若干战斗机。你至少要有 2 架战斗机。等敌机被你的防空单位打伤后，再慢慢去攻击这些被削弱的飞机；有机会就去打轰炸机。

column2: Note: Major modifications from the original. New defense type scenario.
column3: 附注：相对原版有重大修改。新增防御类场景。

column2: Scenario 4: Sicilian Invasion
column3: 场景 4：西西里登陆(Sicilian Invasion)

column2: I bought a Tiger tank, a Moser gun and a mobile AD. Moderate difficulty. A BV is definite possible. I got one in the last turn in my second trial. You should concentrate your troops in the middle victory hexes. Remain in the defensive on the two extreme hexes. You need to concentrate your scattered troops. Do not use your planes for 2 or 3 turns let the AD guns carr y the air defense task. After the planes are weakened try slowly to get rid of them. First, the bombers, after then the fighters. The AI has plenty of tanks in the South beware. Move the Axis fleet to the North. It is critical in supporting an attack t o defend or recovered the northern victory hexes. The AI has sea superiority, but its fleet is divided in two groups North and South. It practically does not use its southern detachment. The Axis always has the initiative, but the Allies put a tough, p ersistent defense.
column3: 我买了一辆 Tiger 坦克、一门 Moser 火炮和一个机动防空单位。难度中等，辉煌胜利完全可能——我在第二次试打中于最后一个回合拿到过。你应把部队集中在中央的几个胜利格上，在最边上两格取守势。你需要把分散的部队收拢起来。前 2 到 3 个回合不要动用飞机，让防空火炮承担防空任务。敌机被削弱后，再慢慢把它们清除掉：先打轰炸机，然后打战斗机。当心 AI 在南面有大量坦克。把轴心舰队调到北面，它在支援防守或夺回北方胜利格时至关重要。AI 有海上优势，但它的舰队分成南北两群，南面那支几乎不用。轴心方始终掌握先手，但盟军的防御顽强而持久。

column2: Note: Major modifications from the original. New defense type.
column3: 附注：相对原版有重大修改。新增防御类型。

column2: Scenario 5: Operation Zitadelle
column3: 场景 5：堡垒行动(Operation Zitadelle)

column2: I bought a Tiger tank, sold my Moser gun and bought a 17k18 gun. I also bought a FW-190. It is advisable to buy planes and infantry in the Russian scenarios and AD units and tanks in the Western Allies scenarios. Artillery guns can be bought in any scenario. In this way your units have a higher possibility to survive until they get experienced. Increasingly unit survival should be th e most important consideration when you want to buy units.
column3: 我买了一辆 Tiger 坦克，卖掉 Moser 火炮，买进一门 17K18 火炮，还买了一架 FW-190。建议在俄国场景买飞机和步兵，在西方盟军场景买防空单位和坦克；火炮在任何场景都可以买。这样你的单位更有机会活到攒出经验。买单位时，单位的存活越来越应该成为最重要的考虑。

column2: Tough scenario. It is an improved version of the original SSI scenario. You have now to take several victory hexes on the Eastern part of the map. The weak point in the Russian defensive struct ure, the western area between the rivers, is protected by heavy bunkers. You start by creating a wall with your tiger tanks and put your guns immediately behind. You patiently pinpoint the Russian supporting guns until you eliminate several of them, use the range differential in your favor (5 to 4). Then is safe to attack the Russian position. After 3 or 4 turns you should have broken through the area between the rivers and have beaten off the tanks attacking your central victory hex. A group should b e gin the attack on the eastern victory hexes. The western group should be divided in two. A smaller group should go Northwest to take the victory hex there, while the other units should go Northeast. Beware of counter-attacks, both, in the air and land. The Russians will still receive substantial reinforcements and you can easily lose some core units. Playing carefully though your victory is never in doubt. Distance is a problem to achieve a BV though. You have victory hexes spread all over the map.
column3: 艰难的场景。它是 SSI 原版场景的改进版。你现在必须攻占地图东部的若干胜利格。俄军防御体系的薄弱点，即两河之间的西部区域，由重型地堡保护着。开局先用 Tiger 坦克排成一道墙，火炮紧跟其后。耐心地逐个锁定俄军支援火炮，直到消灭其中几门；利用射程差优势（5 对 4），此后进攻俄军阵地才是安全的。3 到 4 个回合后，你应已突破两河之间的区域，并击退进攻你中央胜利格的坦克。应有一群开始进攻东面的胜利格；西面那群分成两部：较小的部分向西北去夺取那里的胜利格，其余单位向东北推进。当心空中和地面的反击。俄军仍会得到大量补充兵员，你很容易损失一些核心单位。不过只要打得小心，你的胜利毫无悬念；但距离是拿到辉煌胜利的障碍——你的胜利格散布在整张地图上。

column2: Scenario 6: Orel Bulge
column3: 场景 6：奥廖尔突出部(Orel Bulge)

column2: I bought a Hummel mobile gun, a Tiger tank and a Henschel bomber. Tough scenario. The terrain favors defense. The Russians have already the range 2 tanks. You divide your forces in 3 groups. The middle one is the strongest. You have to pinpoint the defending enemy guns until you eliminate them. After that you can attack. Beware of the enemy tanks, try to lure them away from the AD guns, attack them with the bombers and then with your tanks. The Russians counterattacked in the air and on land. I had three AD units from the previous scenario they were very helpful. I have also a Tiger leader with overwatch. It was very useful, but it was almost destroyed by infantry attacks on rough terrain. A BV can be achieved, but is difficult. I got a victory in the last turn.
column3: 我买了一门 Hummel 自行火炮、一辆 Tiger 坦克和一架 Henschel 轰炸机。艰难的场景。地形利于防御。俄国人已经有射程 2 的坦克。把部队分成 3 群，中间那群最强。你必须逐个锁定防守的敌军火炮，直到将其消灭，之后才能进攻。当心敌军坦克：设法把它们从防空火炮旁引开，先用轰炸机、再用坦克攻击它们。俄国人在空中和地面都发起了反击。我从上一个场景带来 3 个防空单位，非常管用。我还有一名带警戒射击的 Tiger 指挥官，很好用，但差点被崎岖地形上的步兵攻击打掉。辉煌胜利可以拿到，但不容易。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 7: Dniepr Crossing
column3: 场景 7：第聂伯河渡河(Dniepr Crossing)

column2: I bought a Hummel mobile gun, and a bridging infantry unit. Tough scenario. The AI is set in offensive mode. During the first 4-5 you should be in defensive mode. Try to positio n yourself to pinpoint the AI guns by using range differential (5 to 4). It is difficult because some of the AI guns are leaders, making their range also 5. Form 3 groups one in the Northeast, another in the center, West of the main city and prepare a s m all one around your main eastern city. This should have two tanks, one gun, one AT and at least 2 infantry units. The bridging units should be one in each of the other groups. You can attack as soon as the red tide diminishes. It will take 5 to 6 turn s , otherwise you can be badly hurt. The AI will still receive significant reinforcements in tanks and planes. They have at least your level of experience also. You have to take risks to achieve at least a victory. The main problem is to cross your forc e s to the other side of the river. There are only two hexes to cross. One group should take the Northeastern victory hex, the center one should concentrate on the center hex and the eastern group should be able to take the East hex. You should try to co ncentrate a group on the eastern city by the river and then swing from the eastern side of the Dniepr in this way you can use a bridge to cross to the other side. I only got a victory in the last turn.
column3: 我买了一门 Hummel 自行火炮和一个架桥步兵单位。艰难的场景。AI 处于进攻模式。前 4 到 5 个回合你应取守势。设法占位，利用射程差（5 对 4）锁定 AI 的火炮。这很难，因为 AI 有些火炮是指挥官，射程也是 5。编成 3 群：一群在东北，一群在中央、主城以西，再围绕你东面的主城准备一小群。这一小群应有两辆坦克、一门火炮、一个反坦克单位和至少 2 个步兵单位。架桥单位应分到另外两群各一个。等红色浪潮减弱就可以进攻，这需要 5 到 6 个回合，否则你会被打得很惨。AI 仍会得到大量坦克和飞机补充兵员，他们的经验也至少与你相当。要取得至少一场胜利，你必须冒险。主要难题是把部队送过河到对岸——只有两格可以过。一群应夺取东北胜利格，中央那群集中打中央格，东面那群应能拿下东面格。你应设法在河边东城集中一群，然后从第聂伯河东侧迂回，这样就能利用一座桥过到对岸。我只在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 8: Monte Cassino
column3: 场景 8：蒙特卡西诺(Monte Cassino)

column2: You can deploy only 12 u nits, therefore, I only upgraded my units. I took 6 tanks, 2 AD and 4 guns (3 17K18 and 1 Hummel). You should send reinforcements immediately to the group in Monte Cassino. Your troops are strong, but need at least two turns to reach good positions. Y o u form two groups, one on the East and the other on the roads to Cassino. During that time you will loose two victory hexes. The western group, after sending a couple of infantry unit and at least a gun to help the Cassino garrison, will concentrate aro u nd the middle victory hex. You will counterattack from there. Be careful from 2 or 3 turns, then you can advance. You should not have much trouble with the British on the East. The only problem is space. After repelling the American attack at the cen t er victory hex you form two groups, one attacking down the road and the other to help the garrison at Cassino and later to take the French victory hex. As long as you are careful about the Allies long-range guns you should not have much trouble. I run i n to trouble trying to take the last victory hex, though. The AI purchased three guns there, plus the two provided. I lost a couple of auxiliary infantry units and much of the strength of my tanks. I got a victory. The eastern group got a speedy victory , but it was too far away to reinforce the main attack.
column3: 你只能部署 12 个单位，所以我把单位都升级了。我带了 6 辆坦克、2 个防空单位和 4 门火炮（3 门 17K18 和 1 门 Hummel）。你应立即向蒙特卡西诺的那群部队派出补充兵员。你的部队很强，但至少需要两个回合才能到达好位置。你编成两群：一群在东面，一群在通往卡西诺(Cassino)的路上。在这期间你会丢掉两个胜利格。西面那群在派出一两个步兵单位和至少一门火炮去支援卡西诺守军后，应集中在中央胜利格周围，从那里反击。前 2 到 3 个回合要小心，之后就可以推进。东面对付英国人应该没多大困难，唯一的问题是空间。击退美军对中央胜利格的进攻后，你编成两群：一群沿公路进攻，另一群去支援卡西诺守军，随后夺取法国胜利格。只要当心盟军的远程火炮，你应该不会有多大麻烦。不过我在夺取最后一个胜利格时遇到了麻烦：AI 在那里买了 3 门火炮，加上原有的 2 门。我损失了几个辅助步兵单位和我坦克的大部分兵力。我取得了胜利。东面那群很快取胜，但距离太远，无法增援主攻。

column2: Scenario 9: Western Ukraine
column3: 场景 9：西乌克兰(Western Ukraine)

column2: I reinforced my tanks, upgraded an AT to Jag-panther and bought a Hummel mobile gun and a mobile AD. The scenario is tough, but I have played it several times, it helpe d. You can run easily in trouble here and you may never recover. The Soviets will overrun all your victory hexes, but the last one on the city. You have also to split your forces in three groups. The flank groups have to be the stronger ones. The cen t er one should have mostly infantry and AT units. The Soviet planes are also a concern. This is the reason for the extra mobile AD. The AI attacked very fiercely. I played mostly in the defensive all along the front for 3-4 turns. The Hummel guns were very valuable providing support while I placed my long-range 17 K18 guns. After I was able to destroy the Soviet artillery I could destroy the tanks. The AI has several range 2 tanks, very strong. After wining the tank battle on the Northwest I took th e victory hex there and I went straight for the other to the East. The center group took the victory hex directly in its path. The southern group had some trouble with the Soviet tanks there. I lost an infantry unit and a Romanian tank. You need to be careful in the North because the AI got heavy reinforcements there. After some trouble in the South I was able to get a BV in the last turn.
column3: 我补充了我的坦克，把一个反坦克单位升级为 Jag-panther，并买了一门 Hummel 自行火炮和一个机动防空单位。这个场景很难，但我打过好几次，这有帮助。在这里你很容易陷入麻烦且再也翻不了身。苏军会击溃你所有的胜利格，只剩城里的最后一个。你还必须把部队分成三群，两翼那两群必须更强，中央那群应以步兵和反坦克单位为主。苏军飞机也是个隐患，这就是我多带一个机动防空单位的原因。AI 进攻得非常凶猛。我沿着整条战线守了 3 到 4 个回合。在我部署 17K18 远程火炮期间，Hummel 火炮提供了很有价值的支援。在我得以摧毁苏军炮兵之后，就能消灭他们的坦克了。AI 有几辆射程 2 的坦克，很强。在西北赢下坦克战后，我夺取了那里的胜利格，然后直奔东面那一个。中央那群拿下了它正前方的胜利格。南面那群与那里的苏军坦克有些麻烦，我损失了一个步兵单位和一个罗马尼亚坦克。北面要小心，因为 AI 在那里得到了大量补充兵员。在南面经历一些波折后，我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 10: Normandy
column3: 场景 10：诺曼底(Normandy)

column2: You can only deploy 14 units, therefore, I only upgraded one of my Pz IVG2 to King Tiger, I reinforced my units with the rest of my prestige, especially the AD units and planes. . This is a tough scenario. You should win it and relatively fast, but you can loose many units easily. The AI planes are very strong, therefore, I hid my planes d uring the first 3 turns. Let the AD units to defend your troops. You should move the planes closer to the beaches though. Place them close to your Northwestern group. This group will attack from there using at least two strong tanks. You should also a ssemble a southern group that will move towards the North-West. Its mission is to take two victory hexes. You should include at least two good tanks and two long-range guns. Your eastern group will take the inland eastern victory hex. You need to conc e ntrate your forces first though and be careful with the AI planes. You also need to be careful because the AI has several good tanks, they are no match for your experienced Tiger tanks, but they are fast and can seriously damage your guns. I left a Wess e l mobile gun and an infantry unit to take the Eastern beach victory hex. After taking the two inland victory hexes and beating the tanks I went straight for the beaches. You should be careful with the Allied fleet though. They have powerful long-range g uns. They destroyed two of my auxiliary guns. The AI will receive continuously reinforcements at the beaches, especially guns. Use your TB to attack them as soon as you control the air. You need also to be careful protecting your own victory hexes. T he AI will leave strong forces in you back. If you loose one you will not be able to recover it in a reasonable time. I got a BV in the last turn.
column3: 你只能部署 14 个单位，所以我只把我的一辆 Pz IVG2 升级为 King Tiger，用剩下的威望补充单位，尤其是防空单位和飞机。这是艰难的场景。你应该能赢，而且相对较快，但你很容易损失很多单位。AI 飞机非常强，所以前 3 个回合我把飞机藏了起来，让防空单位保护部队。不过你应把飞机向海滩靠近，把它们放在西北那群附近。这群将从那里进攻，至少用两辆强坦克。你还应组建南面一群，向西北方向移动，任务是夺取两个胜利格；其中应至少有两辆好坦克和两门远程火炮。你东面那群将夺取内陆东部的胜利格。不过你首先要集中兵力，并当心 AI 飞机。你还要小心：AI 有几辆好坦克，它们不是你那批老练 Tiger 坦克的对手，但速度快，能重创你的火炮。我留下一门 Wessel 自行火炮和一个步兵单位去夺取东面海滩的胜利格。拿下内陆两个胜利格并打垮坦克后，我直奔海滩。不过你要当心盟军舰队：他们有威力强大的远程火炮，摧毁了我两门辅助火炮。AI 会不断在海滩得到补充兵员，尤其是火炮。一旦掌握制空权，就用你的战术轰炸机(TB)攻击它们。你还要小心保护自己的胜利格：AI 会在你后方留下强兵，一旦丢掉一个，你就无法在合理时间内夺回。我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 11: Red Avalanche
column3: 场景 11：红色雪崩(Red Avalanche)

column2: I upgraded a Pz IVG2 to King Tiger and over-strengthen my tanks especially. This is a tough scenario. After the changes in the first 3-4 scenarios it is more accessible, but still is tough. You assemble two strong groups in the North and South, respectably. You need to be very careful the first 4-5 turns. The AI has very powe r ful tanks and planes. It will punish any mistake. You need to concentrate your forces attacking East along the direct road. Use you long-range guns to slowly destroy the Soviet guns. You have to split your forces again, one group going South and the o t her going East, after capturing the middle victory hex. You need any gun that you can scrap. The AI has good tanks and also good infantry. I almost lost two Tiger tanks (+1000) to direct infantry attacks. The terrain favors the defense. The southern g roup also ran into trouble a couple of times, but I manage to win a victory in the last turn. My Army took a beating though. I had many units with only 4-5 points left. You should be especially careful because it is easy to get a good tank bog-down in a river. The bad position will make it very vulnerable. The player has about 200 more experience points on average that in the beta copy, but at least 4 or 5 units less.
column3: 我把一辆 Pz IVG2 升级为 King Tiger，并特别把我的坦克超编。这是艰难的场景。前 3 到 4 个场景改动之后，它好打一些了，但仍然艰难。你在北面和南面各集结一群强兵。前 4 到 5 个回合你必须非常小心。AI 有非常强的坦克和飞机，任何失误都会受到惩罚。你需要集中兵力沿直路向东进攻，用远程火炮慢慢摧毁苏军火炮。夺取中央胜利格后，你必须再次分兵：一群向南，一群向东。你能拆的火炮都要带上。AI 有好坦克，也有好步兵；我差点在步兵的直接攻击下损失两辆 Tiger 坦克（+1000）。地形利于防御。南面那群也几次陷入麻烦，但我在最后一个回合赢下了胜利。不过我的军队被打得很惨，很多单位只剩 4 到 5 点。你要特别小心，因为好坦克很容易在河里陷住，位置一坏就极为脆弱。玩家的平均经验比测试版多约 200 点，但至少少 4 到 5 个单位。

column2: Scenario 12: Battle of the Bulge
column3: 场景 12：突出部战役(Battle of the Bulge)

column2: I got good prestige for the first time in many s cenarios. I upgraded my Me 109E to Me 262, and one of my AD units to range 3 and strengthen my tanks and planes. You can use only 15 units. I got my 7 tanks, one Jag-Panther, 4 17K18, 1 Hummel (leader) and my 2 best AD units (leaders both). This is an extremely tough scenario and it changes every time you play it. There is a strong dependence on weather. The allies have a tremendous air force, they get many reinforcements and their infantry is very powerful. They can destroy experienced tanks on the snow. I played 3 times before being satisfied with the scenario. You assigned all your Panther tanks to the northern group. They have empty space to fight with enemy tanks. All your planes should also go to the northern group. You should defend the c e ntral and southern groups with AD units. I tried otherwise once and I ended-up without an air force. You move relatively easy at the beginning, but the western victory hex is a nightmare. It is protected by rings of ATs supported by guns and heavy tank s . There are also only two river hexes to cross. The others are impassable, check carefully this situation. You should rush in the North. The northern victory hex is protected from the east and front by heavy guns and AT units. It should be taken from the West. You should rush a group of Panthers to the West and then take the guns that are unprotected from a western attack. You have to clear a tank corps first. You should take a recon with you, there are a couple of AT units that can really harm you . After clearing the guns rush toward the West. Be careful though I got bogged down in the middle of an infantry corps and they destroy a +12 Panther G. I got a victory in the last turn.
column3: 我在很多个场景之后第一次拿到不错的威望。我把我的 Me 109E 升级为 Me 262，把一个防空单位升到射程 3，并加强了我的坦克和飞机。你只能用 15 个单位。我带了 7 辆坦克、一辆 Jag-Panther、4 门 17K18、1 门 Hummel（指挥官）和我最好的 2 个防空单位（都是指挥官）。这是个极其艰难的场景，而且每次玩都不一样，对天气的依赖很强。盟军有庞大的空军，会得到很多补充兵员，步兵也非常强，能在雪地上摧毁老练的坦克。我打了 3 次才对这个场景满意。你应把所有 Panther 坦克编入北面那群，它们有开阔空间与敌军坦克作战；所有飞机也应编入北面那群。中央和南面两群要用防空单位防守。我有一次反着来，结果打完就没有空军了。开局你推进相对轻松，但西面的胜利格是场噩梦：它由一圈反坦克单位保护，还有火炮和重型坦克支援，而且只有两格河流可以渡过，其余都不可通行，请仔细查看这一情况。你应在北面猛冲。北面的胜利格东面和正面都有重炮和反坦克单位保护，应从西面夺取。你应把一群 Panther 快速调到西面，然后打掉那些无法向西面射击的火炮——你得先清掉一个坦克集群。你应带一个侦察单位同行，有几处反坦克单位能真正伤到你。清掉火炮后向西猛冲。不过要小心：我曾在步兵集群中部陷住，他们打掉了一辆 +12 的 Panther G。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 13: Operation Nordwind
column3: 场景 13：北风行动(Operation Nordwind)

column2: Another tough scenario. It has similar characteristics to the previous one. I upgraded one AD to range 3, my best recon to 234/4 and strengthen my tanks and planes. You can deploy only 16 units, 7 tanks and one mobile AT, 4 17K18, 2 Hummel mobile guns, 2 ADs and my 234/4 recon. You move slowly all throughout the attacking perimeter, you should use your paratroopers to help you take some victory hexes. You put them on top of guns during snow turns and them destroy the guns next turn. The AI is too spread out, therefore, slowly you can make progress. Be careful though, it is easy to loose some core units. I got a victory.
column3: 又一个艰难的场景，特点与上一个相似。我把一个防空单位升到射程 3，把我最好的侦察单位升级为 234/4，并加强了我的坦克和飞机。你只能部署 16 个单位：7 辆坦克和一个机动反坦克单位、4 门 17K18、2 门 Hummel 自行火炮、2 个防空单位和我那辆 234/4 侦察单位。你在整个进攻周界上推进缓慢，应利用伞兵帮你夺取一些胜利格：在下雪的回合把他们放在火炮头上，下一回合就能消灭这些火炮。AI 兵力过于分散，所以你可以慢慢取得进展。不过要小心，很容易损失一些核心单位。我取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 14: Operation Konrad
column3: 场景 14：康拉德行动(Operation Konrad)

column2: I have a lot of prestige for the first time. I bought a King Tiger, a Panther and a Henschel TB. I even have prestige to over-s trength and upgrade a second AD to range 3. This is a tremendous scenario. You have everything, but a sea battle here, tank battles, air battles, infantry fights, you attack fortifications, defend, etc. It is a very tough scenario. The AI has many str o ng tanks and planes, its infantry is mostly strength 13 with several levels of entrenchment (3-5). Even you will see for the first time strength 15 infantry. The average experience of the AI army is 550. Those units do not withdraw, you have to destroy them and on top of that the weather is mostly snow. You also have to take victory hexes all over the map. A Hungarian group should take the northern victory hex and then move along the northern edge of the map. A strong group should take the central vi c tory hex and then move northwards. The southern group should be the stronger. It has to battle its way into a strong infantry screen supported by heavy artillery. Tanks will counter-attack you all the time. The southwestern victory hex is very strongl y defended, after breaching the infantry screen and defeating the heaviest tank concentration you should form a especial group with at least 2 heavy guns to take it. Your Panzers aided by a mobile gun can take the middle southern victory hex. At the same time you should have taken the northeastern victory hex. It is heavily fortified and the AI has several guns protecting it. At some point you should use the Budapest garrison to press your attack. Be careful though, if you attack prematurely it will be destroyed. After taking this victory hex you should rush south to take the eastern victory hexes. The Romanian one is heavily defended by a set of AT guns. You should cross the river North of the hex and attack from behind. If any of your tanks gets b o gged-down in the river is gone. The same strategy should be used for the southwestern victory hex. I managed to achieve a victory in the last turn without losing any core unit. The TB units got things moving in the last 3-4 turns otherwise I do not kno w what had happened.
column3: 我第一次拥有大量威望。我买了一辆 King Tiger、一辆 Panther 和一架 Henschel 战术轰炸机，甚至还有威望把第二个防空单位超编并升到射程 3。这是个惊人的场景：除了海战，你在这里什么都有——坦克战、空战、步兵交战、进攻工事、防御等等。它非常艰难。AI 有很多强坦克和飞机，它的步兵大多是兵力 13 且带若干级工事（3-5），你甚至会第一次见到兵力 15 的步兵。AI 军队的平均经验是 550。这些单位不会撤走，你必须消灭它们，而且天气多半是下雪。你还必须夺取遍布全图的胜利格。应让一个匈牙利集群夺取北面的胜利格，然后沿地图北缘移动。一个强力集群夺取中央胜利格，然后向北推进。南面那群应最强，它必须一路打进由重炮支援的厚实步兵屏障。坦克会不断反击你。西南胜利格防守极为坚固；在突破步兵屏障、打垮最密集的坦克集群后，你应编成一支特别集群，带至少 2 门重炮去夺取它。你的 Panzer 在一门自行火炮协助下可以夺取南面中央的胜利格，同时你应已拿下东北胜利格——它工事坚固，AI 有好几门火炮保护它。到某个时候你应动用布达佩斯守军加紧进攻，但要小心：如果进攻过早，守军会被消灭。拿下这个胜利格后，你应向南猛冲夺取东面的胜利格。罗马尼亚那个由一组反坦克炮重兵防守：你应从该格以北过河，从背后进攻。你的任何坦克若在河里陷住就完了。西南胜利格也应采用同样的策略。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利，且没有损失任何核心单位。战术轰炸机(TB)在最后 3 到 4 个回合推动了进展，否则我不知道会怎样。

column2: Scenario 15: The battle for Berlin
column3: 场景 15：柏林之战(The battle for Berlin)

column2: I bought a recon unit and over-strengthened my tanks and planes. I have now 9 tanks, 4 King Tigers (one 1700), 3 Panthers, 2 Tigers (one 2400, overwatch leader, a monster unit!!!); 7 guns, 4 17K18 (no leaders though), 2 Hummels (both leaders, one recon movement) and a Wessel (900 leader); 3 ADs (2 range 3 and one skf6/2), all leaders; two 244/4 recons, 3 fighters (one Me 262 1700) and 2 TBs. I also have two infantry units, one Waffen SS, one Stur m pioniere and a bridging engineers unit. It is a strong army, but just able to do the job as the previous scenario demonstrated. You can deploy only 16 units, I took 8 tanks, 1 mobile AT, 2 AD units and 5 guns (4 17K18 and my leader Hummel). It is a ver y tough scenario. The AI has lots of heavy tanks and planes. You will see the IS3 for the first time. The AI army has in average more than 500 experience points. The infantry has high levels of entrenchments and there are many heavy guns. The ones def e nding Frankfurt are all leaders, therefore, you do not have range differential in your favor. The AI will receive heavy reinforcements on your lost victory hexes. In Breslau will even get bunkers. You should split in three groups. The flank ones shoul d be much stronger than the center one. It is almost impossible to cross the river there. After taking Breslau and Kustrin you should attack the center victory hexes from behind. It is the only way. I learnt it the hard way. I got a victory in the las t turn.
column3: 我买了一个侦察单位，并超编了我的坦克和飞机。我现在有 9 辆坦克：4 辆 King Tiger（其中一辆 1700）、3 辆 Panther、2 辆 Tiger（其中一辆 2400，警戒射击指挥官，怪物单位！！！）；7 门火炮：4 门 17K18（不过没有指挥官）、2 门 Hummel（都是指挥官，其中一门有侦察机动）和一门 Wessel（900，指挥官）；3 个防空单位（2 个射程 3，1 个 skf6/2），全是指挥官；两个 244/4 侦察单位、3 架战斗机（其中一架 Me 262 1700）和 2 个战术轰炸机(TB)。我还有两个步兵单位，一个 Waffen SS、一个 Sturmpioniere 和一个架桥工兵单位。这是一支很强的军队，但正如上一个场景所示，也只够完成任务。你只能部署 16 个单位，我带了 8 辆坦克、1 个机动反坦克单位、2 个防空单位和 5 门火炮（4 门 17K18 和我的指挥官 Hummel）。这是个非常艰难的场景。AI 有大量重型坦克和飞机，你会第一次见到 IS3。AI 军队平均有 500 多点经验，步兵工事等级很高，还有很多重炮。防守法兰克福的火炮全是指挥官，所以你没有射程差优势。AI 会在你丢掉的胜利格上得到大量补充兵员，在布雷斯劳甚至会得到地堡。你应分作三群，两翼那两群应比中央那群强得多——在那里过河几乎不可能。拿下布雷斯劳和屈斯特林后，你应从背后进攻中央的胜利格，这是唯一的办法，我是吃了苦头才学到的。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 16: Summer Storm
column3: 场景 16：夏季风暴(Summer Storm)

column2: The story line goes that after stopping the Soviets in front of Berlin you will attack them in Northeastern Germany to liberate the Fatherland. I bought a 234/4 recon, upgrade my last Tiger (2500, overwatch leader) to Panther II and over-strengthened my tanks and planes. This is not really a tough scenario. It is tough at the beginning when you face the Soviet tanks. They can really scare you, but after 3-4 turns a combination of tanks and TB units should win the d a y. The difficulties are that you have to take victory hexes all over the map and the rough and crisscrossed by rivers terrain. The Soviets have a strong infantry screen supported by guns, but the perimeter they have to defend is so long that you almost i mmediately will break everywhere. You will assemble 4 groups and attack very carefully during the first turns. You will be more successful in the South and you should split your forces into east-bounded and north-bounded groups. You should be careful d u ring the first 3-4 turns, the Soviets have heavy tanks and good planes and they will counterattack fiercely. They will also attack the garrison at Konisberg, using even the small fleet provided. You should create a small mixed amphibian group in the Nor t h while slowly try to wear down and destroy the Soviet fleet. Your northern group should attack toward Konisberg, while your central and southern groups move steadily towards their objectives, Lodz and Warsaw. The center group after capturing Lodz shoul d turn northwards. Warsaw is heavily fortified and defended by heavy guns. Be careful when you enter rough terrain. All the AI infantry is strength 15, it can really hurt you on rough terrain. The infantry in cities is also heavy entrenched. You will n eed anything that can fire before attacking. You should use even the humblest auxiliary unit. You should also be careful because all the AI units have 600-700 experience points. You will have to destroy every single one. The AI does not have enough ta n ks to defend successfully though. A scenario like this requires at least 6 tank corps to be successfully defended. The AI has only 4 (13-15 tanks and mobile AT units). This will be cold comfort if they can surprise you during the first 3-4 turns. The h eaviest tank group will counterattack you when you approach Konisberg from the South. The fortifications in Kreusburg are formidable. It took me a long time to breach them. My victory was never in jeopardy, but my army lost strength steadily. I also l o st Konisberg when I played the scenario. The AI was so strong that could breach the defenses even when my fleet helped. I recovered it pretty soon though. I got a victory and forced the Soviets to sue for peace. This victory ended the campaign (upper path). I barely made to Feld-Marschall though (235 points) with the result of 10 victories and 6 BV.
column3: 故事线是这样的：在柏林城前挡住苏军之后，你将在德国东北部进攻他们，解放祖国。我买了一个 234/4 侦察单位，把我最后一辆 Tiger（2500，警戒射击指挥官）升级为 Panther II，并超编了我的坦克和飞机。这其实不算艰难的场景。开局面对苏军坦克时确实艰难，它们真的会吓到你，但 3 到 4 个回合后，坦克与战术轰炸机(TB)单位的组合就该能取胜。困难在于你必须夺取遍布全图的胜利格，以及地形崎岖、河流纵横交错。苏军有火炮支援的厚实步兵屏障，但他们要防守的周界太长，你几乎能立刻到处突破。你应编成 4 群，前几个回合非常小心地进攻。你在南面会更顺利，应把部队分成向东和向北的两部分。前 3 到 4 个回合要小心：苏军有重型坦克和好飞机，会猛烈反击。他们还会进攻柯尼斯堡(Konisberg)守军，甚至动用提供的那支小型舰队。你应在北面编一支小型混成两栖集群，同时慢慢消耗并摧毁苏军舰队。北面那群应向柯尼斯堡进攻，中央和南面两群则稳步向目标罗兹(Lodz)和华沙(Warsaw)推进。中央那群夺取罗兹后应转向北。华沙工事坚固，由重炮防守。进入崎岖地形时要小心：AI 步兵全是兵力 15，在崎岖地形上真能伤到你。城市里的步兵工事也很厚。进攻前你需要一切能开火的东西，连最不起眼的辅助单位也要用上。你还要小心，因为 AI 所有单位都有 600-700 点经验，你必须把它们一个个全部消灭。不过 AI 没有足够的坦克来成功防守，像这样的场景至少要 6 个坦克集群才能守住，而 AI 只有 4 个（13-15 辆坦克和机动反坦克单位）。但如果你在前 3 到 4 个回合被它们打个措手不及，这也算不上什么安慰。当你从南面接近柯尼斯堡时，最重的坦克集群会反击你。克鲁斯堡(Kreusburg)的工事非常坚固，我花了很长时间才突破。我的胜利从未受威胁，但军队实力持续下降。我打这个场景时还丢过柯尼斯堡——AI 强到即使我的舰队帮忙也能突破防御，不过我很快就夺了回来。我取得了胜利，迫使苏军求和。这场胜利结束了战役（上层路径）。我勉强升到陆军元帅(Feld-Marschall)（235 分），战绩为 10 场胜利和 6 场辉煌胜利。

column2: My final army was 9 tanks, 4 King Tigers (1950, 1800, 1750, 1600, all leaders), 3 Panthers G (1800, 1600, 1500, 2 leaders), 1 Tiger (2600, overwatch lead er, a monster unit!!!) and 1 Panther II (250); 7 guns, 4 17K18 (no leaders though), 2 Hummels (both leaders, one recon movement) and a Wessel (1100 leader); 3 AD units (2 range 3 and one Skf6/2), all leaders; two 234/4 recons (1800, 220), 3 fighters (one Me 262 1700), all leaders, 2 TB units (850, 250), and 1 Sturmpioniere unit (980), 1 Waffen SS (750), 2 Infanterie units (800, 560) both leaders and one Bruckenpioniere unit (200).
column3: 我的最终军队是 9 辆坦克：4 辆 King Tiger（1950、1800、1750、1600，全是指挥官）、3 辆 Panther G（1800、1600、1500，2 个指挥官）、1 辆 Tiger（2600，警戒射击指挥官，怪物单位！！！）和 1 辆 Panther II（250）；7 门火炮：4 门 17K18（不过没有指挥官）、2 门 Hummel（都是指挥官，其中一门有侦察机动）和一门 Wessel（1100，指挥官）；3 个防空单位（2 个射程 3 和 1 个 Skf6/2），全是指挥官；两个 234/4 侦察单位（1800、220）；3 架战斗机（其中一架 Me 262 1700），全是指挥官；2 个战术轰炸机(TB)单位（850、250）；1 个 Sturmpioniere 单位（980）、1 个 Waffen SS（750）、2 个 Infanterie 单位（800、560，都是指挥官）和 1 个 Bruckenpioniere 单位（200）。

column2: Scenario 17: Don River (#2 lower)
column3: 场景 17：顿河(Don River)（下层 #2）

column2: You will be sent here if you lost or on ly got a TV in Stalingrad. It is a tough scenario. You have to defend against strong Soviet attacks. You have mostly Italian and Hungarian units without heavy weapons. You do not have much of an air force either. Luckily is snowing most of the time. Y o u have to support your allies in the northern and southern victory hexes as soon as possible. The northern group should have more tanks and AT units than the southern one, most of the guns should go there. After 6-7 turns you should have worn down enoug h the attack in the North. You should counter-attack with everything you have. Leave only an infantry unit and the non-mobile AT and AD units there. If you do not counterattack or do it late you will not be able to get at least a victory. You do not ha v e enough force. You should attack the southernmost victory hex while the northern group is moving south taking the victory hexes on its way. Be careful with counterattacks, timing is everything here. The South victory hex is well defended by guns and i nfantry. I managed to get a victory in the last turn.
column3: 如果你在斯大林格勒失败或只拿到战术胜利，就会被送到这里。这是个艰难的场景。你必须防御苏军的强攻。你的部队大多是意大利和匈牙利单位，没有重武器，空军也不成气候。所幸大部分时间在下雪。你必须尽快支援北面和南面胜利格里的盟军。北面那群应比南面那群有更多坦克和反坦克单位，大部分火炮也应调到那里。6 到 7 个回合后，你应已把北面的进攻消耗得差不多。这时你应投入一切力量反击，只留下一个步兵单位和不能机动的反坦克、防空单位。如果你不反击或反击太晚，就无法取得至少一场胜利——你没有足够的兵力。北面那群向南推进、沿途夺取胜利格时，你应进攻最南端的胜利格。当心反击，这里的时机决定一切。南面的胜利格由火炮和步兵严密防守。我在最后一个回合设法取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 18: Pantelleria (#3 lower)
column3: 场景 18：潘泰莱里亚(Pantelleria)（下层 #3）

column2: You move to the Mediterranean Sea from Russia. You have to take this island just away from the coast of Africa. You can deploy only four units, 2 Tiger tanks, one 17K18 gun and my best AD. Western Allies always mean very strong air force, therefore, you have to be careful during the first turns. Keep your planes together and let the AD units do the defense. Use the ships to attack the British guns, they are the main threat there. You should try to take one of the central victory hexes and the airfield as soon as possible. You cannot deploy planes until you have taken the airfield. You have to do it with the auxiliary planes. As soon as you have cleared the c e ntral victory hexes you should try to take a port. This is the key to victory. Your force is enough to take all the victory hexes, but the easternmost one. You need more strength to do that. You should be careful during the first turns to have one of y our tanks attacked by a bomber/several tanks combination. In order to take the last victory hex you need your fleet to be very active, attack the allied guns and try at least to distract the enemy fleet if you can not control the sea. You cannot approac h your guns until you have fended off the enemy fleet. Once you can fire with 2 or 3 guns everything will be all over. I managed to get a BV in the last turn.
column3: 你从俄国转到地中海，必须夺取这座离非洲海岸不远的岛屿。你只能部署 4 个单位：2 辆 Tiger 坦克、1 门 17K18 火炮和我最好的防空单位。西方盟军就意味着非常强的空军，所以前几个回合你必须小心。把你的飞机集中在一起，让防空单位负责防御。用舰船攻击英国火炮——它们是那里的主要威胁。你应尽快夺取一个中央胜利格和机场。在拿下机场之前你不能部署飞机，只能靠辅助飞机。清掉中央胜利格后，你应设法夺取一个港口，这是取胜的关键。你的兵力足以夺取所有胜利格，只有最东面那个除外，那需要更多兵力。前几个回合要小心你的某辆坦克被轰炸机与数辆坦克的组合攻击。要夺取最后一个胜利格，你需要舰队非常活跃：攻击盟军火炮，如果无法控制海域，至少设法牵制敌军舰队。在击退敌军舰队之前，你无法让你的火炮接近。一旦能有 2 到 3 门火炮开火，一切就都结束了。我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 19 Kerch (#4 lower)
column3: 场景 19：刻赤(Kerch)（下层 #4）

column2: This is a tough scenario. You can only deploy 14 frontline units , the rest can enter through the ports, but that is slow. I upgraded to my first King Tiger here and I bought a Hummel mobile gun. The AI is set in attack mode, you will lose Kuban, Staxiansky and the western airfield within 2 turns. The remaining vict o ry hex in the eastern part of the straits will be under very heavy attack, try to reinforce it by sea. You should set up a front line just west of Kuban with very strong artillery support. It will take you 2-3 turns to stop the Soviets and then you can c ounter-attack. The Soviets have several strong tanks and will get reinforced in your lost victory hexes, therefore, expect a heavy fight. I sent a strong armor group to the north and then moved south. It was heavy fighting all along, my army fell to an average of 4-5 points, and my units got almost 200 experience points in the scenario. I got a victory.
column3: 这是个艰难的场景。你只能部署 14 个一线单位，其余可以从港口进入，但那样很慢。我在这里升级出第一辆 King Tiger，并买了一门 Hummel 自行火炮。AI 处于进攻模式，你会在 2 个回合内丢掉库班(Kuban)、Staxiansky 和西部机场。海峡东部剩下的那个胜利格将遭到极猛烈的进攻，设法从海上增援它。你应在库班以西建立一条战线，配以非常强的炮兵支援。你需要 2 到 3 个回合才能挡住苏军，之后才能反击。苏军有几辆强坦克，并会在你丢掉的胜利格得到补充，所以要准备打一场硬仗。我派了一个强装甲集群向北，然后转向南。一路都是激战，我的军队平均降到 4 到 5 点，单位在这个场景里涨了将近 200 点经验。我取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 20: Mussolini
column3: 场景 20：墨索里尼

column2: s Rescue (#5 lower)
column3: 的营救（下层 #5）

column2: This is a composite scenario. The victory is achieved through some especial ability of the units involved. You can deploy only 3 units, my best tank, gun and recon. The scenario was designed for this strategic plan, you take the central victory hex using your tank, gun and 1-2 infantry units. Then, you sent your recon escorted by planes to move in a huge c i rcle around all the units, only a recon could do this because it has literally to dribble past several AT guns, it will even take some hits along the way. You should protect him by using at least one fighter. It will be lost if hit from the air. The we s ternmost victory hex is its destination, the one close to the airfield. While you are doing this you send your infantry and paratroopers towards the western airfield, support them with the gun and tank as soon as this is possible. Be careful with the pl a nes. You should occupy the airfield with at least one paratrooper unit. Once you do this fly it to the airfield on the eastern part of the map, be careful it should be heavily escorted and place the paratrooper only in safe places, there are many AD gun s all over. After the paratroopers are gone you can try to fly some other infantry unit. I never managed to get a BV!!!
column3: 这是个复合场景，胜利要靠参战单位的某些特殊能力来实现。你只能部署 3 个单位：我最好的坦克、火炮和侦察单位。这个场景就是为这一战略计划设计的：你用坦克、火炮和 1-2 个步兵单位夺取中央胜利格；然后派侦察单位在飞机护送下绕所有单位兜一个大圈——只有侦察单位能做到，因为它实际上得带球绕过好几门反坦克炮，沿途还会挨几次打。你应至少用一架战斗机保护它；它若被空中击中就会损失。最西面的胜利格是它的目的地，就是靠近机场的那个。在此期间，你把步兵和伞兵派往西部机场，一有可能就用火炮和坦克支援他们。当心飞机。你应至少用一个伞兵单位占领机场；一旦得手，就把它空运到地图东部的机场——要小心，必须重兵护航，而且只把伞兵放在安全位置，周围有很多防空炮。伞兵撤走后，你可以试着再空运一个步兵单位。我从没能拿到辉煌胜利！！！

column2: Scenario 21: Invasion Salerno (#6 lower)
column3: 场景 21：萨莱诺登陆(Invasion Salerno)（下层 #6）

column2: This is a tough scenario at the beginning, especially in the northern and central British vi ctory hexes. You have a strong fleet. Use it to support your attack. Especially attack the artillery and the French ships. Slowly wear the Allied ships and planes down until you get control of the air and sea. After that it is easy, even though the A llies have many strong planes and tanks. I got a BV in the last turn.
column3: 这个场景开局艰难，尤其是在英国防守的北部和中部胜利格。你有一支强大的舰队，用它支援你的进攻，尤其要攻击炮兵和法国舰船。慢慢消耗盟军舰船和飞机，直到掌握制空权和制海权。之后就容易了，尽管盟军有很多强飞机和坦克。我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 22: Gomel (#7 lower)
column3: 场景 22：戈梅利(Gomel)（下层 #7）

column2: This is a tough scenario. The AI is set on attacking mode. You should set a defensive line by the southern Romanian victory hex. You should counter-a ttack in a wide front from there. You split in 3 groups the stronger the central one. Use your guns to clear the approaches to Gomel and then to take the city. You can also take the northern victory hex by the river and then move southwards attacking t he troops at Gomel from behind. The southern group should cross the river and take the final victory hexes on the South. Beware of counterattacks because the AI is reinforced there. I managed to get a BV in the last turn.
column3: 这是个艰难的场景。AI 处于进攻模式。你应在南面的罗马尼亚胜利格一带建立防线，并从那里在宽正面上反击。你把部队分成 3 群，中央那群最强。用火炮扫清通往戈梅利的接近路，然后夺取该城。你也可以夺取河边的北方胜利格，然后向南推进，从背后攻击戈梅利的部队。南面那群应过河，夺取南面最后的几个胜利格。当心反击，因为 AI 在那里会得到补充。我在最后一个回合设法拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 23: Assault at Monte Cassino (#8 lower)
column3: 场景 23：蒙特卡西诺突击(Assault at Monte Cassino)（下层 #8）

column2: This is not a tough scenario, but you have to cover a lot of ground and the terrain is rough. You set-up two groups, the stronger one along the central road and the other on the coast. Your troops are also scattered at the beginning of the scenario, therefore, it takes about 2 turns to concentrate them. After concentration you attack along the central road toward Isernia and along the coast. You need to destroy a strong tank group on the coast before attacking the first victory hex there. The AI has very powerful planes, therefore, you need to be careful during 3-4 turns. Mostly let you AD units to defend your army. You have plenty anyway. After taking Isernia you split your army into a smaller group toward Cassino with the Fren c h victory hex as its final destination. You assign a couple of guns, a good tank, an AD and two infantry units. The remaining units should press the attack along the road while the other group is moving along the coast. It will succeed taking both vict o ry hexes there, but it will have trouble joining the rest of the army for the final assault on the last supply hex. You have to be careful here because the AI has a strong fortified position protected by a ring of AT units supported by several heavy guns . I got a BV in the last turn when I playtested it. I added some Allied units later, therefore, it should be a little harder now. You get good prestige out of the scenario.
column3: 这个场景不算艰难，但你要覆盖很大范围，而且地形崎岖。你编成两群：较强的一群沿中央公路，另一群在海岸。开局你的部队也是分散的，所以大约需要 2 个回合才能集中。集中后沿中央公路向伊塞尔尼亚(Isernia)进攻，同时沿海岸推进。进攻海岸第一个胜利格之前，你需要先消灭那里一个强坦克集群。AI 有非常强的飞机，所以前 3 到 4 个回合要小心，主要让防空单位保护你的军队——反正你防空单位很充足。拿下伊塞尔尼亚后，把军队分出一支较小的集群向卡西诺推进，最终目标是法国胜利格；给它配两门火炮、一辆好坦克、一个防空单位和两个步兵单位。其余单位应沿公路加紧进攻，同时另一群沿海岸移动。它能成功夺取那里的两个胜利格，但很难与主力会合参加对最后一个补给胜利格的最后突击。这里你要小心，因为 AI 有一个坚固的工事阵地，由一圈反坦克单位守卫，还有若干重炮支援。我试打时在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。后来我又加了一些盟军单位，所以现在应该更难一点。你能从这个场景拿到不错的威望。

column2: Scenario 24: Cherkassy (#9 lower)
column3: 场景 24：切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)（下层 #9）

column2: This is a very tough scenario. The AI is s et at attacking mode and in the first 2-3 turns will overrun all your victory hexes, but Cherkassy itself. You should be under heavy pressure there also. You relay on heavy artillery and a mobile AT to defend. You should split your forces in 3 groups. The southern one should be the strongest. It is the one that has to relieve Cherkassy. Your Romanian and Hungarian units will not last more than 2-3 turns. You should withdraw wherever you can and then approach fast with your battle groups. The snowy w eather is a permanent problem. You also have to take victory hexes all over the map and be careful defending Cherkassy, a premature counterattack there can lead to lose the hex and the game. The AI has many heavy tanks and planes, be careful. I manage a victory in the last turn. I lost a couple of infantry units in Cherkassy itself before some units of the central group reinforced me. In one of the playtests the AI attacked the Romanian units on the West. It destroyed almost all. Only the more mobil e could join German battle groups and relatively safety.
column3: 这是个非常艰难的场景。AI 处于进攻模式，前 2 到 3 个回合会击溃你所有的胜利格，只有切尔卡瑟城本身除外。你在那里也会承受很大压力。你依靠重炮和一个机动反坦克单位防守。你应把部队分成 3 群，南面那群应最强，因为它要解切尔卡瑟之围。你的罗马尼亚和匈牙利单位撑不过 2 到 3 个回合。能撤的地方就撤，然后用你的战斗群快速接近。下雪的天气是长期的麻烦。你还必须夺取遍布全图的胜利格，同时小心防守切尔卡瑟——在那里过早反击可能导致丢掉该格乃至输掉全局。AI 有很多重型坦克和飞机，要小心。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。在中央那群的部分单位增援我之前，我在切尔卡瑟城内损失了几个步兵单位。有一次试打中，AI 进攻了西面的罗马尼亚单位，几乎把它们全歼，只有机动性较好的才能加入德军战斗群并相对安全。

column2: Scenario 25: Transnistria (#10 lower)
column3: 场景 25：德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)（下层 #10）

column2: This is a very tough scenario. You have to take several victory hexes under very tough conditions. The terrain is rough all around. The eastern victory hex es are defended by guns and heavy bunkers. You can move mostly on roads with only a few bridges to cross several rivers. You create 3 groups, the two flank ones should be the strongest, especially the southern one with at least two heavy long-range guns . Beware of the Soviet infantry, it can really hurt your tanks on rough terrain. I managed to take the northern victory hex by the river, but I was strongly counterattack and I lost several auxiliary units there. The hex changed hands 4 or 5 times. Luc kily I got a victory before things got too hot. It is important to take the Soviet central airfield to use effectively your planes.
column3: 这是个非常艰难的场景。你必须在极为艰苦的条件下夺取若干胜利格。四周地形崎岖。东面的胜利格由火炮和重型地堡防守。你基本只能沿公路机动，而跨越几条河只有少数几座桥。你编成 3 群，两翼那两群应最强，尤其是南面那群，应带至少两门远程重炮。当心苏军步兵，他们在崎岖地形上真能伤到你的坦克。我设法夺取了河边的北方胜利格，但遭到猛烈反击，在那里损失了好几个辅助单位，该格易手 4 到 5 次。所幸在局势变得太糟之前我取得了胜利。夺取苏军中央机场很重要，这样才能有效使用你的飞机。

column2: Scenario 26: Sevastopol Evacuation (#11 lower)
column3: 场景 26：塞瓦斯托波尔撤离(Sevastopol Evacuation)（下层 #11）

column2: This is another composite scenario. You have to achieve victory by using some especial abilities of the units involved. The engineers' ability to blow-up bridges was the chosen ability, unfortunately, a bug makes the AI to ignore blown-up bridges, therefore, I had to muffle this ability. The key plan is, you have to assembl e a strong group to take the northern Soviet victory hex. You are also going to loose your Romanian victory hex there. You should even withdraw from it before your forces are destroyed trying to defend it. The engineers should also move northwards blowi n g bridges as they go. You can deploy only 4 units, your 2 better tanks and 2 17K18 long-range guns. By turn 2-3 you should have your mobile forces positioned just east of the lost Romanian victory hex. You should attack from there. Once you assemble y o ur forces it is easy. You should also use your paratroopers by the center airfield, drop them on top of the last victory hex. If you do not get a BV victory you may not get any victory at all. The rest of your units should be on the defense. Cooperate with the defense by moving a couple of infantry units close to the bridges. They are going to be destroyed, but they will buy time for you. You cannot stop the Soviet tanks. Speed and concentration of forces on the North is your only chance. I got a B V victory in the last turn.
column3: 这是另一个复合场景，你必须借助参战单位的某些特殊能力取胜。工兵炸桥的能力就是被选中的能力，可惜有个 bug 让 AI 无视被炸毁的桥梁，所以我只好把这个能力削弱了。关键计划是：你必须集结一个强力集群去夺取北面的苏军胜利格。你还会丢掉那里的罗马尼亚胜利格——甚至在部队因守它而被消灭之前就该撤出。工兵也应向北移动，边走边炸桥。你只能部署 4 个单位：你较好的 2 辆坦克和 2 门 17K18 远程火炮。到第 2-3 回合，你的机动部队应已就位于丢掉的罗马尼亚胜利格以东，你应从那里进攻。一旦集结完毕，就很容易了。你还应把伞兵用在中央机场，把他们空投到最后一个胜利格上。如果你拿不到辉煌胜利，可能什么都拿不到。其余单位应转入防御。配合防御的办法是把一两个步兵单位调近桥梁：他们会被消灭，但能为你争取时间。你挡不住苏军坦克。唯一的胜机是在北面以速度和兵力集中取胜。我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利。

column2: Scenario 27: Viipuri Counterattack (#12 lower)
column3: 场景 27：维普里反击(Viipuri Counterattack)（下层 #12）

column2: This is a tough scenario. You can deploy close to the front only 12 units, 6 tanks, 4 guns (3 17K18 and 1 Hummel), 1 AD and 1 recon. The rest can be deployed at the ports, but it will take time for them to approach. You are divided in 3 groups, you should take the offensive with the western group just outside Viipuri, the southern group should stay in the defensive and for 2-3 turns you should also stay in the defensive with t h e eastern one. The Soviets have strong artillery there, your Finnish units are no match for them. You should have at least strong tanks by now (King Tiger, Panther G or experienced Tigers), use them to spearhead the attack on Viipuri. Pinpoint the Sovi e t artillery with you long-range guns. After 5-6 turns you should have broken into Viipuri, when you tanks start rolling out of the city attack with the other two groups. Send some of your troops by sea to reinforce the southern group. The combined powe r of the 3 groups should be enough to give you a victory. Be careful though with the troops on the eastern port. You cannot approach the port directly, therefore, you have to use long-range artillery. The Soviets will get reinforcements by the southern airfield, just when you are advancing towards it. Be careful, keep your formation, do not rush. You should be able to defeat them, but they can destroy a couple of your core units. I got a victory.
column3: 这是个艰难的场景。你在前线附近只能部署 12 个单位：6 辆坦克、4 门火炮（3 门 17K18 和 1 门 Hummel）、1 个防空单位和 1 个侦察单位。其余可以部署在港口，但需要时间才能接近。你被分成 3 群：你应让维普里城外的西面那群转入进攻；南面那群取守势；东面那群前 2 到 3 个回合也取守势。苏军在那里有很强的炮兵，你的芬兰单位不是对手。到这时你应至少有强坦克了（King Tiger、Panther G 或老练的 Tiger），用它们带头攻击维普里。用你的远程火炮锁定苏军炮兵。5 到 6 个回合后，你应已突入维普里；当你的坦克开始驶出城市时，用另外两群发起进攻。派一部分部队从海上增援南面那群。3 群的合力应足以让你取得胜利。不过要当心东面港口附近的敌军：你无法直接接近港口，所以必须使用远程炮兵。你向它推进时，苏军会从南部机场得到补充兵员。小心，保持队形，不要冒进。你应该能击败他们，但他们可以打掉你一两个核心单位。我取得了胜利。

column2: Scenario 28: St. Lo (#12 lower)
column3: 场景 28：圣洛(St. Lo)（下层 #12）

column2: This is a tough scen ario. You can deploy only 12 units 6 tanks, 4 guns (3 17K18 and 1 Hummel) and 2 AD units. You have to be careful with the Allies Air Force it is very strong. Hide your planes for a couple of turns, let the AD units to carry the defense. You are well p r ovided, but you should still take a couple into the scenario. I already had a range 3 unit. You should concentrate on the bombers first and the weakened planes afterwards. The AI is in attacking mode. You are going to lose all your victory hexes, but S t. Lo itself. You should create a defensive line running perpendicular to the coast, all the way to the victory hex. You are even going to be heavily attack there. If you loose it, you loose the scenario. After clearing the skies and containing the at t acks you will counterattack. It took me 4-5 turns. You attack in 3 groups, starting from the West, the AI has strong artillery and tanks and will get reinforced in your lost victory hexes. You will be able to make it through with careful play, but spac e is a problem. The last victory hexes are too far away and you will have to take chances to take them on time. I got a brilliant victory in the last turn. I was awarded a Panther F prototype.
column3: 这是个艰难的场景。你只能部署 12 个单位：6 辆坦克、4 门火炮（3 门 17K18 和 1 门 Hummel）和 2 个防空单位。你必须当心盟军空军，它非常强。把你的飞机藏两三个回合，让防空单位扛住防御——你的防空配置不错，但仍应带几个进场景，我那时已经有射程 3 的单位了。你应先集中打轰炸机，之后再打被削弱的飞机。AI 处于进攻模式。你会丢掉所有胜利格，只有圣洛城本身除外。你应建立一条垂直于海岸、一直延伸到该胜利格的防线，那里也会遭到猛攻。一旦丢掉它，你就输掉这个场景。清空天空、遏制住进攻后，你就反击。我用了 4 到 5 个回合。你分 3 群进攻，从西面开始；AI 有很强的炮兵和坦克，并会在你丢掉的胜利格得到补充。小心行事你能打过去，但空间是个问题：最后几个胜利格太远，你不得不冒险才能按时拿下。我在最后一个回合拿到了辉煌胜利，并获得了 Panther F 原型。

column2: Scenario 29: Bastogne (#13 lower)
column3: 场景 29：巴斯托涅(Bastogne)（下层 #13）

column2: This is a very tough sc enario. You should use your prestige to over strengthen your units. You have to divide your forces in 3 groups. Be very careful especially with the western group. I ran into trouble early there. The AI has strong tanks and they destroyed one of my au x iliary tanks there. The terrain is bad and it is easy to get bogged-down in a dangerous position. Your tanks are vulnerable if bogged-down in rivers. The eastern group made good progress though. I had a leader recon (strength 16) with devastating fire ability it really helped attacking artillery from behind. You should not try to overreach though. It is snow all the time, therefore, you do not know what is behind, normally is nasty. Despite the strength of my groups I ran into trouble attacking the l ast victory hexes in the North-West. My army was well battered by them with most units only at half strength. I had to continue attacking with core units that had only 4-5 strength points. I finally manage to get a TV. One of my tanks, the prototype P anther F, got 300+ experience points in the scenario. It was the unit that got more experience points ever in a scenario I played. It was almost destroyed 3-4 times though.
column3: 这是个非常艰难的场景。你应用威望去超编你的单位。你必须把部队分成 3 群，尤其要当心西面那群——我在那里过早陷入麻烦。AI 有强坦克，他们打掉了我那里一辆辅助坦克。地形很差，很容易在危险位置陷住；坦克陷在河里就很脆弱。不过东面那群进展顺利。我有一个指挥官侦察单位（兵力 16），火力凶狠，从背后攻击炮兵时非常管用。你也不要贪进。一直下雪，所以你不知道后面藏着什么，通常都不是好事。尽管我的各群实力不弱，进攻西北最后几个胜利格时还是遇到了麻烦。我的军队被打得很惨，多数单位只剩半血，我不得不继续用只有 4-5 点兵力的核心单位进攻。我最终只拿到战术胜利(TV)。我的一辆坦克——就是 Panther F 原型——在这个场景里涨了 300 多点经验，是我玩过的场景中单场景涨经验最多的单位，不过它也差点被摧毁 3-4 次。

column2: Scenario 30: Budapest (#14 lower)
column3: 场景 30：布达佩斯(Budapest)（下层 #14）

column2: This is the last time you can assemble your whole army. You will need it though. It is an extremely difficult scenario. The AI starts with 15 brand new tanks and mobile AT units. It will get more as reinforcements later on. You divide into 3 groups, the southern one has to be the stronger, the northern one can the weakest. You face an infantry screen with heavy artillery support. There are several tanks ready to counterattack as well. The weather is mostly snow, but be careful the AI has very strong planes. Sometimes I had to defend my plan e s by making a "ball" of them. Play conservatively during the first 4-5 turns. After breaking through the infantry screen you should take the northern victory hex first. There are a couple of nasty guns there though. The center group should be about to take the victory hex on the tip of the river. The rivers were a big problem though because of the ground bug, they were not frozen most of the time. It will take 6-7 turns to take the southern victory hex. In approximately 10 turns you should have take n all these victory hexes and you should turn southwards toward the river victory hexes. The southern group should aim for the Romanian victory hex. Be careful there is plenty of Soviet armor there. The Budapest garrison cannot support the attack. Ther e are many Soviet heavy guns surrounding the city. Your northern group can destroy them from behind, but it will take too much time and strength. It is not worth it. You should cross your forces east of the river when attacking the central victory hexes . It is easier to attack them from the rear. The ground bug will once again hurt you. In the south it will help you though. The big Soviet concentration of tanks will not attack you there because of this. It will give you time to plan your attack. Be very careful there, during playtesting I counted 8 tanks and mobile AT units there. The AI played in a very smart way the scenario, something unusual. It concentrated the tanks, setting ambushes using the reduced visibility, instead of attacking in unco ordinated waves as normally does. I managed to get a TV.
column3: 这是你最后一次能集结全部军队的机会——不过你也需要它。这是个极其艰难的场景。AI 开局就有 15 辆全新的坦克和机动反坦克单位，之后还会得到更多补充。你分成 3 群，南面那群必须最强，北面那群可以最弱。你面对的是有重炮支援的步兵屏障，还有若干坦克随时准备反击。天气多半下雪，但要当心 AI 有非常强的飞机。有时我不得不把飞机摆成一个「球」来防守。前 4 到 5 个回合保守行事。突破步兵屏障后，你应先夺取北面的胜利格，不过那里有几门难缠的火炮。中央那群应快要夺取河口的那个胜利格。河流是个大麻烦，因为地面 bug，它们大部分时间没有结冰。夺取南面胜利格需要 6 到 7 个回合。大约 10 个回合后，你应已拿下这些胜利格，然后转向南，朝河边的胜利格推进。南面那群应以罗马尼亚胜利格为目标，当心那里有大量苏军装甲。布达佩斯守军无法支援进攻，城周围有很多苏军重炮。北面那群可以从背后摧毁它们，但会花掉太多时间和兵力，不值得。进攻中央胜利格时，你应从河以东渡过部队，从后方进攻更容易。地面 bug 会再次害你，不过在南部它反而帮你：苏军的大规模坦克集群因为这个 bug 不会在那里进攻你，这让你有时间筹划进攻。那里要非常小心，试打时我数到有 8 辆坦克和机动反坦克单位。AI 在这个场景里打得很聪明，这很少见：它集中坦克，利用降低的视野设置埋伏，而不是像平时那样一波波毫无协同地进攻。我设法拿到了战术胜利(TV)。

column2: Scenario 31: Berlin Defense (#15 lower)
column3: 场景 31：柏林防御(Berlin Defense)（下层 #15）

column2: This is another tough scenario. I over-strengthened my tanks and upgraded my last Tiger to King Tiger. You have to set 3 battle groups. The group in Fur stenwalde should just close the road to the Soviet tanks. The southern group should be the stronger. At least 3 good tanks and 2 long-range guns should be there. You have to take the victory hex in front of it, then cross the Oder channel and after tha t split in a small southern group and a northern bound one. Its final destination is the victory hex at the airfield. The central group should be the second in strength. It has to defeat at least a Soviet tank group before attacking the Frankfurt victor y hex. The northern group has to attack in an arc from the North and take the Soviet northwestern victory hex. You should be careful because the Soviets have a lot of strong artillery on the Oder banks. This group should take Seelow, join forces with th e northern group and attack eastwards towards Kustrin. There are only two river hexes and the Soviets will counterattack after receiving heavy reinforcements there. By the time you get in front of the last victory hexes you will be in the time limit for v ictory. You need to hurry and charge in masse. You will loose some units, but you should succeed. I got a victory in the last turn. I lost a couple of auxiliary tanks and 3 infantry units in the last rush. The southern group breaking from the airfiel d decided the battle for me.
column3: 这是又一个艰难的场景。我超编了我的坦克，并把我最后一辆 Tiger 升级为 King Tiger。你必须设置 3 个战斗群。菲尔斯滕瓦尔德(Furstenwalde)的那群只需封住通往苏军坦克的道路。南面那群应最强，至少要有 3 辆好坦克和 2 门远程火炮。你必须夺取它正前方的胜利格，然后渡过奥得河(Oder)河道，之后分成向南的一小群和向北的一群，最终目标是机场的胜利格。中央那群实力应排第二，它必须在进攻法兰克福胜利格之前先击败至少一个苏军坦克集群。北面那群必须从北面呈弧形进攻，夺取苏军的西北胜利格。你要小心，因为苏军在奥得河岸边有很多强炮兵。这群应夺取塞洛(Seelow)，与北面那群会合，然后向东朝屈斯特林进攻。那里只有两格河流，苏军在得到大量补充后会反击。等你推进到最后几个胜利格前时，已经在胜利时限之内了。你需要赶快集中兵力猛冲。你会损失一些单位，但应该能成功。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利：在最后冲锋中损失了几辆辅助坦克和 3 个步兵单位。从机场突围而出的南面那群为我决定了战局。

column2: I played the lower path using the linear campaign provided. I barely made to Feld-Marschall, 230 points. My final army was 7 tanks, 3 King Tigers (1800, 1650, 1400, all leaders), 3 Panthers G (1300, 1100, 1000, 2 leaders), 1 Tiger (1600, aggressive attack leader, a monster unit!!!) and 1 Panther II (350); 6 guns, 4 17K18 (3 leaders), 2 Hummels (both leaders); 3 ADs (1 range 3 and 2 skf6/2s), all leaders; two 234/4 recons (1500, 420), both leaders, 3 fighters (one Me 262 1400 ) , all leaders, 2 TBs (650, 350), and 1 Sturmpioniere unit (600), leader, 1 Waffen SS (650 leader), 2 Infanterie units (600, 560) both leaders and one Bruckenpioniere (300, leader). You can compare this lower campaign army with the upper one (scenario 16) .
column3: 我使用提供的线性战役打完了下层路径。我勉强升到陆军元帅(Feld-Marschall)，230 分。我的最终军队是 7 辆坦克：3 辆 King Tiger（1800、1650、1400，全是指挥官）、3 辆 Panther G（1300、1100、1000，2 个指挥官）、1 辆 Tiger（1600，勇猛攻击指挥官，怪物单位！！！）和 1 辆 Panther II（350）；6 门火炮：4 门 17K18（3 个指挥官）、2 门 Hummel（都是指挥官）；3 个防空单位（1 个射程 3 和 2 个 skf6/2），全是指挥官；两个 234/4 侦察单位（1500、420），都是指挥官；3 架战斗机（其中一架 Me 262 1400），全是指挥官；2 个战术轰炸机(TB)（650、350）；1 个 Sturmpioniere 单位（600，指挥官）、1 个 Waffen SS（650，指挥官）、2 个 Infanterie 单位（600、560，都是指挥官）和 1 个 Bruckenpioniere（300，指挥官）。你可以把下层战役的这支军队与上层那支（场景 16）作比较。
